InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Read input: rtlpp_04115_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_04115 (
      output reg [ 3: 0] fill_level,
      
      input              clk,
      input              reset,
      
      output reg         in_ready,
      input              in_valid,
      input      [36: 0] in_data,
      
      input              out_ready,
      output reg         out_valid,
      output reg [36: 0] out_data
);

   parameter DEPTH = 8;
   parameter DATA_WIDTH = 37;
   parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 3;

   reg [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_addr;
   reg [ADDR_WIDTH:0] rd_addr;
   reg [ADDR_WIDTH:0] next_wr_addr;
   reg [ADDR_WIDTH:0] next_rd_addr;
   reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] mem[DEPTH-1:0];
   reg empty;
   reg full;
   reg out_ready_vector;
   reg [ADDR_WIDTH:0] mem_rd_addr;
   
   always @(*) begin
      out_ready_vector = out_ready;
      in_ready  = !full;
      next_wr_addr = wr_addr + 1;
      next_rd_addr = rd_addr + 1;
      fill_level[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] = wr_addr - rd_addr;
      fill_level[ADDR_WIDTH] = 0;

      if (full)
           fill_level = DEPTH;
   end

   always @ (posedge reset or posedge clk) begin
      if (reset) begin
         wr_addr  <= 0;
         rd_addr  <= 0;
         empty    <= 1;
         full     <= 0;
         out_valid<= 0;
      end else begin
         out_valid <= !empty;
         if (in_ready && in_valid) begin
            wr_addr <= next_wr_addr;
            empty   <= 0;
            if (next_wr_addr == rd_addr)
              full <= 1;
         end

         if (out_ready_vector && out_valid) begin
            rd_addr <= next_rd_addr;
            full    <= 0;
            if (next_rd_addr == wr_addr) begin
               empty <= 1;
               out_valid <= 0;
            end
         end

         if (out_ready_vector && out_valid && in_ready && in_valid) begin
            // Maintain the current state of full and empty if both read and write happen simultaneously
            full  <= full;
            empty <= empty;
         end
      end
   end

   always @(*) begin
      mem_rd_addr = rd_addr;
      if (out_ready && out_valid) begin
        mem_rd_addr = next_rd_addr;
      end
   end

   always @ (posedge reset or posedge clk) begin
      if (reset) begin
        mem[0] <= 38'h0;
      end else begin 
         if (in_ready && in_valid) 
            mem[wr_addr[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]] <= in_data;
      end
      out_data = mem[mem_rd_addr[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]];
   end
   
endmodule
